mapper.insert: insert into notify_task( activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, create_time, update_time) values( #{activityId}, #{teamId}, #{notifyCategory}, #{notifyType}, #{notifyMQ}, #{notifyUrl}, #{notifyCount}, #{notifyStatus}, #{parameterJson}, #{uuid}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select activity_id, team_id, notify_category, notify_type, notify_mq, notify_url, notify_count, notify_status, parameter_json, uuid, update_time from notify_task where notify_status in (0, 2) or (notify_status = 4 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)) limit 50
mapper.update: update notify_task set notify_status = 4, notify_count = notify_count + 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and (notify_status in (0, 2) or (notify_status = 4 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)))
update notify_task set notify_status = 1, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
update notify_task set notify_status = 3, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
update notify_task set notify_status = 2, update_time = now() where team_id = #{teamId} and uuid = #{uuid} and notify_status = 4
